#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const ll mod = 1000000007;
const ll INF = (ll)1e18 + 1;

ll nCr[100][100];

ll f(ll p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p = p * nCr[a][b] % mod;
    p = p * nCr[c][d] % mod;
    return p;
}

struct State {
    int x, y, z;
    State(int x, int y, int z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;

    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i) nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 50) cnt1++;
        else cnt2++;
    }

    ll dist[200][200][2];
    ll dp[200][200][2];
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
            dist[i][j][0] = dist[i][j][1] = INF;
            dp[i][j][0] = dp[i][j][1] = 0;
        }
    }
    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;

    vector<State> cur;
    cur.emplace_back(0, 0, 0);

    while (!cur.empty()) {
        vector<State> next;
        for (const State& s : cur) {
            int x = s.x;
            int y = s.y;
            int z = s.z;
            ll d = dist[x][y][z];

            if (z == 0) {
                int rx = cnt1 - x;
                int ry = cnt2 - y;
                for (int a = 0; a <= rx; a++) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= ry; b++) {
                        if (a + b == 0) continue;
                        if (a * 50 + b * 100 > K) break;
                        int nx = x + a;
                        int ny = y + b;
                        int nz = 1;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                            ll add = f(dp[x][y][z], rx, a, ry, b);
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                                next.emplace_back(nx, ny, nz);
                            }
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + add) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int rx = x;
                int ry = y;
                for (int a = 0; a <= rx; a++) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= ry; b++) {
                        if (a + b == 0) continue;
                        if (a * 50 + b * 100 > K) break;
                        int nx = x - a;
                        int ny = y - b;
                        int nz = 0;
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                            ll add = f(dp[x][y][z], rx, a, ry, b);
                            if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                                next.emplace_back(nx, ny, nz);
                            }
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + add) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        cur = move(next);
    }

    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF) {
        cout << -1 << '\n';
    } else {
        cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';
    }
    cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';

    return 0;
}
